CPRCompendiums.EI.bungee-cord: Bungee cords are used for almost anything from holding a load down to restraining a hostage. They range in size but all are stretchable cords, usually capped by hooks on each end.
CPRCompendiums.EI.chop:
Cost: 1 eb (Dirt Cheap) + amount of money being loaded (you get that money back on the Chop).

A standard credit chip used to hold electronic cash. They come in two forms. WORM (Write Once, Read Many) Chops are preloaded with a specific amount of money and usually purchased from an Oasis or bodega. You can slot a WORM Chop as many times as you like, but once the funds run out, throw it away because it can’t be reloaded. WORM Chops are sometimes secured with a passcode or biometric information.

R/WM (Read/Write Many) Chops are rarer and usually purchased from financial institutions. R/WM Chops are used like a portable bank and can be loaded and reloaded with cash via an app like BangMe! R/WM Chops are almost always secured with a passcode or biometric information.

Cracking a secured Chop requires an Electronics/Security Tech Check. The DV depends on the level of encryption. A simple, bodega-bought WORM Chop might be DV13 while a fancy R/WM Chop from Eurobank would be at least a DV21. Once a Chop is cracked, the hacker can reset it to require a new passcode or biometric signature.
CPRCompendiums.EI.cigarettes-generic:
Cost: 10 eb (Cheap) per pack of 20.

The classic burnable death sticks. Most cigarettes sold in Night City contain no actual tobacco. Instead, a combination of cheaply grown substitutes (aka weeds) are soaked and laced with various chemicals and flavoring then wrapped in CHOOH² wheat husk paper. The most important of the chemicals is a synthetic and highly addictive nicotine.
CPRCompendiums.EI.cigarettes-biotechnica:
Cost: 50 eb (Costly) per pack of 20.

Made with real, genetically-engineered tobacco straight from North Carolina farms and wrapped in classic cigarette paper, Biotechnica Cigarettes come in a variety of flavored brands including Real Man (jalapeño), Swiss Alps (chocolate), Trailmaster (smoked beef), Fields of Green (strawberry), Haight (hashish), and Pure Imagination (cotton candy).
CPRCompendiums.EI.cigarillo-nomad:
Cost: N/A.

Treasured by nomad elders, these short, narrow cigars are rich tobacco hand rolled in tobacco leaves and usually stored in decorated humidors passed down from generation to generation. Most nomads would rather endure torture than reveal the source of the tobacco used. If a nomad elder offers you one, that’s an sign of trust and not to be undervalued.
CPRCompendiums.EI.continental-brands-end:
Non-addictive! Effective! The favorite flavored beverage of sports stars! Continental Brands EndurU is the perfect blend of fats, carbohydrates, electrolytes, and chemicals to keep your body fueled at an optimal level!

Drinking a can of EndurU grants the user +1 to Endurance Checks for two hours, after which they crash and suffer a -1 to Endurance Checks for one hour. Effects are not cumulative.
CPRCompendiums.EI.cushions:
Sometimes, you want something soft to plant your butt on or lean against. Cushions do the job.

“Cushions ain’t essential? Shit! You drive for twelve hours straight on Broken Highway, then take a break with your back and ass bruised and battered, then tell me they ain’t essential.” —Theo Gallaghar
CPRCompendiums.EI.danshi-badgemaker:
Perfect for the independent employer, club, or con artist, the Danshi Badgemaker produces professional quality ID badges complete with RFID chips you can key to a NET Architecture’s defenses.

A Danshi Badgemaker adds +2 to Forgery Checks when creating fake ID badges.
CPRCompendiums.EI.datatel-image-wallet: A self-contained electronic documentation carrier. Biometrically activated, an Image Wallet can be used to carry and display SIN cards, CIN cards, and other important documents. A favorite of the cautious and AI-phobic who want to carry multiple documents without relying on an Agent and SAAI.
CPRCompendiums.EI.datatel-treasure:
Imagine the cheapest, knock-off wristwatch you can buy. No one would want it, right? No one would bother to steal it, even the most hopped up boosterganger. That’s the DataTel Treasure! It looks so pitiful no one will try to take it from you … and so they won’t discover the hidden memory chip compartment built into the underside.

Finding a memory chip concealed in a DataTel Treasure requires beating a DV21 Conceal/Reveal Object Check.
CPRCompendiums.EI.dinghy:
The classic rowboat beloved by fishing enthusiasts everywhere, fitted with an outboard motor. You might spend more time bailing it out than piloting it.

SDP: 20. Seats: 4. Speed (Combat): 10 MOVE. Speed (Narrative): 15 MPH/24 KPH. Upgrades: None. Nomad Access: 1.
CPRCompendiums.EI.foambag: The beanbag chair of the future is here! Pull this foam ball from your pocket, toss it hard on the ground, and watch in amazement as it expands into a stable blob that conforms to your body shape and provides the perfect seat! Available exclusively from Dock 13.
CPRCompendiums.EI.gun-cleaning-kit:
A gun cleaning kit consists of solvents, lubricants, a cleaning rod, a collection of brushes, cleaning cloths, and an app for your Agent that will perform a control unit reset on smartgun links to clear temporary fault codes and erase bad adaptive data.

If a firearm is well maintained by a Gun Cleaning Kit, the time it takes to repair it, if damaged or destroyed, is 1 hour. This does not change the DV of the repair Skill Check.
CPRCompendiums.EI.hammock: A foldable sling made out of fabric or netting. When suspended between two points it can be used as a seat or bed.
CPRCompendiums.EI.iec-micro-mate-blender: IEC may be gone, but estimates suggest that, in its heyday, the megacorp made one blender for every person on the planet. Available in a variety of colors and tough enough to purèe kibble. If you’re at a Night Market and you don’t see one of these for sale, you’re probably high on Blue Glass and hallucinating that you’re a Night Market.
CPRCompendiums.EI.kiroshi-multiscope:
This revolutionary multi-lensed device from Kiroshi eliminates the need for separate optical tools! With a touch of a button, the Multiscope can switch from a magnifying lens to a monocular, allowing the user to view both the very small and the very distant with ease!

The Kiroshi Multiscope can function as a microscope (400x magnification) or a monocular (3x magnification). Switching modes does not require an Action.
CPRCompendiums.EI.leads-autotan: The ozone layer is flat-out busted, so long-term exposure to sunlight is a good way to catch cancer. If you can’t get to a parlor and don’t want the permanency of ChemSkin, inject a canister of Lead’s Autotan and you’ll glow with a healthy bronze shine for 24 hours.
CPRCompendiums.EI.leads-bodyfree-mask:
These thin, transparent bio-plastic devices don’t hide your face. Instead, they perfect it by erasing wrinkles, blemishes, undereye bags, and frown and smile lines. Wear one and show your best face to the world!

Anyone trying to read the expressions of someone wearing a Bodyfree Mask suffers a -1 to their Human Perception Check.
CPRCompendiums.EI.leads-radiation-ring:
As seen on Hot Zone Divers! Lead’s Radiation Rings change color when exposed to radiation, from violet for chill safety to crimson for red hot rads!

A Lead’s Radiation Ring turns bright red and grows warm when approaching an area with high level radiation (see CP:R page 181).
CPRCompendiums.EI.microtech-trode-set:
Trodes connect on one end to a cyberdeck and on the other to the user’s temples via self-sticking electrodes, allowing them to piggyback onto a netrun.

Trodes allow an adjacent character to observe the cyberdeck user’s netrun. The observer is a passive participant and cannot use NET Actions, but is also immune to the dangers encountered while visiting a NET Architecture. Trodes do not take up an option slot on the cyberdeck.
CPRCompendiums.EI.militech-armor-patch-k:
A kit containing modular plating, pre-mixed adhesives, and reinforced patches that makes armor repair easy.

A Militech Armor Patch Kit can be used to restore an armor’s SP to full so long as it is only 3 SP or less under its maximum. The process takes 1 hour and does not require a Check. Each Armor Patch Kit is good for one application.
CPRCompendiums.EI.petrochem-speedfill:
Petrochem brings its famous construction resin to the home market with SpeedFill, a spray foam that hardens in seconds to fill gaps, cracks, and holes in your broken surfaces. Don’t huddle in your home. Keep out the cold with SpeedFill!

Applying SpeedFill requires 5 minutes and restores 3d6 HP to damaged but intact (1 HP or more) 2 m/yds x 2 m/yds section of Cover, up to its maximum. SpeedFill does not dry transparently, so when applied to bulletproof glass it obscures vision through it. SpeedFill can only be applied to a section of Cover once. After that, further damage must be repaired using an appropriate Skill. Each can of SpeedFill is good for one application.
CPRCompendiums.EI.portable-stove: A portable ceramic stove roughly the size of a tool box. Most come equipped with two burners, a tiny oven space, and are run by burning either biomatter, such as wood, or gas fuel, such as propane.
CPRCompendiums.EI.small-generator: A suitcase-sized generator of electric power that supplies enough power to run six blender-sized appliances – or charge up to six batteries. A gallon of CHOOH² fuels the generator at full output for four hours.
CPRCompendiums.EI.sovoil-neochew:
Cost: 5 eb (Dirt Cheap) per pack of 10.

A favorite of Techs everywhere, microplastic-packed NeoChew is guaranteed to plug a leak – and your intestines if you swallow it – and remains full of flavor for up to three whole minutes! Available in pine, bumbleberry, Continental Brands Koff Pop, pickled beetroot, vodka, and heart pepper.
CPRCompendiums.EI.worldsat-newsdeck: A portable reader capable of logging onto a CitiNet and downloading and displaying screamsheets and news according to a user’s preferences. Useful for AI-adverse readers who want the convenience of portable, electronic news without the dangers of an SAAI knowing their business.
CPRCompendiums.EI.zetatech-flopscreen: A flexible OLED screen. When rolled up, it is small enough to fit into a pocket. When unrolled, it flattens into a 12 inch (30.48cm) square videoboard that can display content projected via AltLink from an Agent.
CPRCompendiums.EI.zetatech-holotank: Consisting of a clear cylinder capped at both ends with high-definition laser projectors, a Holotank is filled with a highly-reflective, non-toxic gas into which a static or animated hologram is projected. The sealed environment enhances the fidelity of displayed holograms far beyond most commercial devices, creating gorgeous displays of art.
CPRCompendiums.EI.bodyfree-mask-effect: The mask makes the wearer's expressions harder to read. Apply the rule in the item description to the observer's check.
